interface.shortDescription: Scientific figures from paper text using your existing Codex sign-in.
interface.longDescription: Reference-driven scientific figures through separate native Codex agents, original PaperVizAgent role prompts, and iterative critique/regeneration. Existing Codex sign-in; no API keys or model configuration.
